recruiterCard.summary: Built a finance-operations reconciliation workflow that aligns multi-source data, enforces schemas, and produces auditable outputs with much lower manual review time.
impactBullets: Built reconciliation pipelines across multi-source datasets, cutting manual review time by 80%.
Generated audit-trail reports with schema enforcement, validation checks, and traceability logging.
Structured the workflow to make exceptions visible while keeping the core process repeatable and reliable.
